dependencies.configuration: F-CUT-001 CutoverConfigurationRevision identified exactly by the immutable configurationRevisionId/configurationCode/configurationRevisionNo frozen on F-CUT-002 task creation
dependencies.task: F-CUT-002 CutoverTask in SURVEYING with effective submitted assessment and complete immutable configuration identity
dependencies.files: F-PLT-001 public FileArtifact fact and CUT FileBusinessObjectPolicyProvider
dependencies.collection: INT-12 consumer port only; provider and collection engine are out of scope

lifecycles.taskTransition: SURVEYING -> PLAN_DRAFTING only after checklist submit; grade D never creates a checklist

matching.configurationIdentitySource: task.configurationRevisionId + task.configurationCode + task.configurationRevisionNo; never current time, CUTOVER_DEFAULT, cutoverType or an arbitrary published revision
matching.extensionDimensions: only enabled dimensions frozen in the same published configuration revision
matching.requiredMerge: true when any compatible matched rule requires the item
matching.conflict: persist all conflicting rule identities and require one explicit valid selection before submit
matching.gap: persist configuration gap and allow task-level custom items; never fabricate a matched system item
matching.rematch: preserve an answer only when stableItemKey and itemDefinitionVersion remain applicable; removed results stay historical

resultSelection.currentRule: one open selection interval per checklist item
resultSelection.switch: close old selection and append the new result in one CUT transaction
resultSelection.collectionMeaning: technical result reference only; never means item passed
resultSelection.manualFallback: retain failed automatic/external fact and select a MANUAL result with authorized evidence

filePolicy.scopeVersion: ProjectScopeApi treeVersion revalidated for the task project

physicalMapping.answer_snapshot: complete immutable PLT public file fact
physicalMapping.manual_evidence_file_reference: the same fact's stable referenceKey only

forbidden: client supplied file fact as authority

internalPorts.configuration: CUT reads the published F-CUT-001 revision through a narrow CUT-owned query service
internalPorts.collection: create request and inspect result reference only; no connector or provider in F-CUT-003
internalPorts.externalData: query request and stable failure only; provider is out of scope

transactionAndLocks: before the write transaction use public non-locking inspect and CUT read projections to freeze projectId, taskId, assessmentId, checklistId and expected versions without business writes
first write lock: ProjectScopeApi.lockAndRevalidate expected treeVersion
then revalidate any other required owner facts in the existing F-CUT-002 global order
lock CutoverTask then effective submitted assessment
lock current checklist root and expected checklist version
lock checklist items in stableItemKey order
close old result selections then append new results
on submit mark checklist SUBMITTED, transition task to PLAN_DRAFTING and append stage history in the same CUT transaction

events.name: CutoverChecklistItemResultLinked
events.meaning: one CUT result version was selected for one checklist item
